mapper.sql: id, name, type, location, description, image_url, capacity, price_per_hour, open_time, close_time, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sports_facility ORDER BY type, name
SELECT FROM sports_facility WHERE type = #{type} ORDER BY name
SELECT FROM sports_facility ORDER BY type, name LIMIT #{start}, #{size}

SELECT DISTINCT f.* FROM sports_facility f WHERE f.status = 1 AND f.id NOT IN ( SELECT facility_id FROM reservation WHERE reservation_date = #{reservationDate} AND status IN (0, 1) AND NOT (end_time <= #{startTime} OR start_time >= #{endTime}) ) ORDER BY f.type, f.name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sports_facility (name, type, location, capacity, price_per_hour, max_duration, open_time, close_time, image_url, description, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{type}, #{location}, #{capacity}, #{pricePerHour}, #{maxDuration}, #{openTime}, #{closeTime}, #{imageUrl}, #{description}, 1)
